CREATE_SHOP_INFO.TEXT: Kumannaanka isticmaalayaal izyGlam ah ayaa u baahan goob cunto… (u qaabee ganacsigaaga!)

STEP1.TITLE: Ka shaqee shuruudahaaga
STEP1.TEXT: U habeey jadwalkaaga oo si xor ah u maamul adeegyadaada. Ka faa’iidayso madal dabacsan oo la jaanqaada baahidaada.

STEP2.TITLE: Xoojiso joogitaanka onlaynka
STEP2.TEXT: Soo jiid macaamiil badan adoo adeegsanaya qalabka suuqgeynta ee app-ka iyo muuqaal korodhsan.

STEP3.TITLE: Daacad-geli macaamiisha
STEP3.TEXT: Samee xiriirro waara adigoo falanqaynaya doorbidka, uga jawaabaya faallooyinka, oo siinaya faa’iidooyin daacadnimo.

STEP1.TITLE: Sahlidda maareynta ganacsigaaga
STEP1.TEXT: IzyGlam waxa ay bixisaa xal dhamaystiran oo loogu talagalay xirfadlayaasha daryeelka. Qalab dabacsan + taageero shakhsiyeed.

STEP2.TITLE: Kordhi iibkaaga
STEP2.TEXT: Maalin kasta, kumannaan qof ayaa adeegsada izyGlam si ay u helaan khubaro qurux. Ka faa’iidayso fursaddan.

STEP3.TITLE: Qanacsanaan la hubo
STEP3.TEXT: Bixi khibrad gaar ah: maamul ballamaha, la xiriir si degdeg ah, oo u adeeg si habboon. Macaamiishu waxay helayaan daryeel meel kasta, wakhti kasta.

STEP1.TITLE: Shaqaalaha iyo macaamiishu way qabsanayaan adeegyo
STEP1.TEXT: Waxay si toos ah uga xulanayaan app-ka izyGlam.

STEP2.TITLE: Adigu ayaad go’aamisaa miisaaniyadda
STEP2.TEXT: Waxaad kabtaa koontooyinka shaqaalaha/macaamiisha—joogto ama hal mar.

STEP3.TITLE: Adeegyada waa la fulinayaa
STEP3.TEXT: Khabiiradeenna ayaa u taga shaqaalahaaga ama xafiiska si ay u qabtaan adeegyada la dalbaday.

CREATE_COMPANY_INFO.TITLE: Qiimee shirkaddaada
CREATE_COMPANY_INFO.TEXT: Kumannaanka isticmaaleyaal ayaa raadinaya adeegyo daryeel. Sii kooxahaaga iyo macaamiishaada helitaan gaar ah khubaro degaankooda ah.

STEP1.TITLE: Daacad-gelin & abaalmarin shaqaalaha
STEP1.TEXT: Siiyo miisaaniyad bil kasta oo qurux ah. Timo-jare, esthetician iwm — si loo kordhiyo qanacsanaanta iyo ka go’naanshaha.

STEP2.TITLE: Kordhi sumcadda astaanta
STEP2.TEXT: Samee dhacdooyin qurux ama ku dar adeegyada barnaamijyada daacadnimada. Ka tag xusuus wanaagsan.

STEP3.TITLE: Hagaaji fayo-qabka shaqada
STEP3.TEXT: Ka dhig adeeggu mid la heli karo goobta shaqada ama meel u dhow. Tani waxay kobcisaa dhiirigelinta iyo wadajirka.

STEP1.TITLE: Sahlidda fayo-qabka kooxahaaga
STEP1.TEXT: IzyGlam waxay bixisaa xal fudud oo dabacsan—qurux iyo tababar jimicsi—dhammaan hal meel.

STEP2.TITLE: Sii macaamiisha faa’iidooyin cusub
STEP2.TEXT: Xooji xiriirka adigoo bixinaya adeegyo daryeel dhacdooyinka ama daacadnimada.

STEP3.TITLE: Daryeel la habeeyay, meel kasta
STEP3.TEXT: Shaqaalaha iyo macaamiisha waxay helayaan adeegyo tayo leh meel kasta; khubaro la soo xulay iyo taageero shakhsiyeed.

AVIS.TITLE: MAXAA KU YIRAHA ISTICMAALAYAASHA
AVIS.AVIS1: Markii hore waan shaki qabay… hase yeeshee! Manicure-kaygu wuu cajiibnaa, gurigayga, dhibaato la’aan. Wuxuu noqday caadadayda Jimcaha fiidkii.
AVIS.AVIS2: Saddex daqiiqo gudaheed baan uga dalbaday daryeel wejiga fadhiga sariirta. Esthetician-ku aad buu u dabacsanaa, dhegaysan… maqaarkayguna weligiis sidan uma fiicnayn.
AVIS.AVIS3: Waxaan moodayay inuu ka qaalisan yahay saloon… la yaab: isla qiime, xataa mararka qaar ka jaban! Manaan u baahnayn inaan baxo. Waa haa weyn.
AVIS.AVIS4: Habeenkii ka hor dhalasho, waxaan rabay brushing degdeg ah. Laba guji ayaan ku helay qof diyaar ah. Waqtiyeyn, wacan, natiijo qurux badan.
AVIS.AVIS5: Waxaan ahay hooyo kali ah, waqti uma hayo orod. Halkan, markay carruurtu seexdaan ayaan ballansadaa. Way fududdahay, degdeg ah, runtii way fiican tahay.
AVIS.AVIS6: Fadhigeygii koowaad waan jeclaaday. Esthetician-ku waxay igu abuurtay raaxo isla markiiba. Waxaan dareemayay in la daryeelay. Hore baan u ballansaday usbuuca dambe!

DECLARATION.TEXT: izyGlam waxay ka go’an tahay in adeeggeedu u furnaado dhammaan. Ujeeddadeennu waa WCAG 2.2 AA iyo waafaqid RGAA (France) intii suurtagal ah.

DATE.TEXT: Bayaanka waxaa la diyaariyey 25 December 2025. Ugu yaraan sanadkiiba mar ayaa la cusboonaysiin doonaa ama marka isbeddello waaweyn dhacaan.

HELP.QUESTION2: Sideen u doortaa xirfadle iigu habboon?
HELP.QUESTION3: Sideen u beddelaa ama u joojiyaa ballankayga?
HELP.QUESTION7: Ma ka tagi karaa faallo ka dib adeegga?
HELP.QUESTION9: Maxaan sameeyaa haddii ay dhibaato timaado?
HELP.QUESTION11: Sidee u shaqeeyaa siyaasadda kansalka & lacag-celinta?
HELP.QUESTION12: Ma u ballansan karaa qof kale (hadiyad, yaab)?
HELP.REPONSE1: Way fududahay oo degdeg. Marka aad is diiwaangeliso, dooro adeegga aad rabto, ka hel xirfadlayaal agagaarkaaga, ka dibna dooro taariikh iyo saacad. Riix "Ballan" si aad u dhamaystirto, ka bixi kaarka bangiga. Xirfadluhu gacanta ayuu u xaqiijin doonaa ballanka. Haddii la diido, si buuxda ayaa laguu soo celiyaa.
HELP.REPONSE2: Xirfadle kasta wuxuu leeyahay profile faahfaahsan: adeegyo, qiime, sawirro shaqo & faallooyin. Waxaad ku dari kartaa kuwa aad jeceshahay. Is barbar dhig profiles si aad u doorato kan kugu habboon.
HELP.REPONSE3: Waxaad ku beddeli/joojin kartaa ballankaaga goobtaada shakhsiga. Kansalku waa bilaash ilaa 24 saac ka hor. Ka dib, kharash ayaa jiri kara. Haddii ay dhibaato timaado, taageeradayadu way ku caawin doonaan.
HELP.REPONSE4: Gali goobtaada, qaybta "Ballamadayda". Halkaas waxaad ka arkaysaa raadraaca waqtiga-dhabta, kansal/beddel, iyo taariikhda adeegyada.
HELP.REPONSE5: Bixintu waxaa lagu sameeyaa kaliya kaar (Visa, MasterCard, American Express). Ma aqbalno lacag caddaan ah ama PayPal. Ammaan buuxa.
HELP.REPONSE6: Marka ballanka la xaqiijiyo, waxaad heli doontaa e-mail soo koobid. Waxaan sidoo kale kuu soo diri doonaa xusuusin (e-mail iyo/ama push). Xaaladda waxaad ka arki kartaa goobtaada.
HELP.REPONSE7: Haa. Kadib adeeg kasta, waxaa lagu weydiinayaa faallo. Faallooyinka waxaa gacanta u habeeya kooxda si loo xaqiijiyo runnimada. Xirfadlayaashu ma beddeli karaan mana ka jawaabi karaan.
HELP.REPONSE8: Waqtigan,izyGlam wali ma laha barnaamij daacadnimo ama koodhadh dhimis. Waxay ku jirtaa qorshaha mustaqbalka.
HELP.REPONSE9: Nala soo xiriir qaybta "Xiriir" ama e-mail. Kooxdeennu waxay ku dadaali doonaan inay kuugu jawaabaan 24 saac gudaheed (qiyaas) oo ay xalliyaan dhibaatada sida ugu dhaqsaha badan.
HELP.REPONSE10: Nala soo xidhiidh foomka bogga ama app-ka. Taageero macaamiil ayaa diyaar ah Isniin–Sabti, 9–18. Tusaale e-mail: [support@izyglam.com](mailto:support@izyglam.com)
HELP.REPONSE11: Waxaad kansali kartaa bilaash ilaa 24 saac ka hor. Ka dib, kharash ayaa jiri kara. Haddii xirfadluhu diido ka dib bixinta, lacag-celin 100% ah. Nidaamka otomaatigga ah weli wuu socdaa.
HELP.REPONSE12: Weli si toos ah uguma hadiyayn kartid qof kale. Si kastaba, haddii xirfadle uu bixiyo duo/qoys, waxaad ballansan kartaa dhowr qof.
HELP.REPONSE13: Adigu ma tahay esthetician, timo-jare ama xirfadle fayo-qabka? Ku biir bulshadaizyGlam adigoo buuxinaya foomka "Noqo lammaane". Kooxdu way kula soo xirmi doonaan si ay u dhammaystiraan diiwaangelinta.
HELP.REPONSE14: Amniga xogtaadu waa mudnaanteena. Waxaan u hoggaansanaa GDPR. Kaliya xogta lagama maarmaanka u ah adeegga ayaa la siinayaa xirfadlaha. Farriimo ku dhex jira app-ka ayaa kuu oggolaanaya isgaarsiin ammaan ah; isku dayga hareer-marinta madasha waa la daba geli doonaa.

WHO.TITLE: Yaan nahay?
WHO.TEXT: Siyaasaddan Qarsoodigu waxay sharxaysaa sida izyGlam ("annaga", "annaga/keenna" ama "Madalka") u ururiso, u isticmaasho, u kaydiso, u wadaagto uguna ilaaliso xogtaada gaarka ah marka aad adeegsanayso adeeggeyaga (web, app web, app mobile, e-mail & support). Waxaan u shaqaynaa sidii mas’uulka ka ah xog-maalgelinta ee hawlaha hoos ku qoran.

SCOPE.TITLE: Baaxadda siyaasadda
SCOPE.TEXT: Waxay khusaysaa macaamiisha adeeg qabsada, xirfadlayaasha adeegyo ku bixiya izyGlam, iyo booqdayaasha is-dhexgalkeena.

PROVIDED.TITLE: Xog aad bixiso
PROVIDED.L1: Aqoonsi & xiriir: magac, e-mail, telefoon, cinwaan(yada), sawir/avatars.
PROVIDED.L3: Ballamo: adeegyo la doortay, taariikh/saacad, cinwaanno adeeg, qoraallo, lifaaqyo.
PROVIDED.L4: Bixin: xogta bixinta via bixiye (tusaale Stripe) — annagu ma hayno xogta kaarkaaga.
PROVIDED.L5: Xirfadlayaal: profile dadweyne, adeegyo, qiime, aagag, helitaan, RIB/IBAN (amniga), dukumiinti xaqiijin haddii loo baahdo.
PROVIDED.L6: Taageero: farriimo, tigidhyo, duubisyo wicitaan haddii ay jiraan.

AUTOMATIC.TITLE: Xog si toos ah loo ururiyo
AUTOMATIC.L1: Farsamo: qalab, OS, browser, xalal, aqoonsi kalfadhi.
AUTOMATIC.L3: Goob: meel qiyaas ah (IP) ama sax (GPS — oggolaansho cad).

PURPOSES.TITLE: Ujeeddooyin & saldhig sharci
PURPOSES.L3: Amni & ka hortag khiyaano — Dano sharci, waajib sharci.
PURPOSES.L6: Suuqgeyn toos ah (e-mail/app) — Oggolaansho marka loo baahdo; waad ka bixi kartaa mar kasta.

SHARING.TITLE: La wadaagista xogta
SHARING.L1: Xirfadlayaal / Macaamiil: xog lagama maarmaan u ah adeegga (magac, xiriir, cinwaan, faahfaahin ballan).
SHARING.L2: Bixiyeyaasha: bixin (Stripe), martigelin/kaydin, analytics, e-mail/SMS push, support, KYC. Helitaan xadidan, qandaraasyo GDPR-waafaqsan.
SHARING.L3: Lammaane: haddii aad oggolaato dalabyo gaar ah.
SHARING.L4: Hay’ado: marka sharcigu dalbado ama si aan u difaacno xuquuqdeena.

TRANSFERS.TITLE: Gudbinta xogta ka baxsan EU/EEA
TRANSFERS.TEXT: Marka xog loogudbiyo dalal aan lahayn go’aan iswaafaqid, waxaan isticmaalnaa qodobbada qandaraaska caadiga ah iyo tallaabooyin dheeraad ah.

RETENTION.TITLE: Muddooyinka haynta
RETENTION.L1: Akoon & aqoonsi: inta la adeegsanayo, dabadeed ilaa 3 sano (soo xidhiidh) ama 5–10 sano (xisaab/waajibyo).
RETENTION.L3: Log-yada amniga: 6–24 bilood iyadoo ku xiran muhiimadda.
RETENTION.NOTE: Ka dib, xogtu waa la tirtiraa ama la magac-la’aan yeelaa.

COOKIES.TITLE: Cookies & SDK
COOKIES.TEXT: Waxaan adeegsanaynaa cookies/SDK si aan u shaqaysiino madasha, u cabbirno isticmaalka, uga hortagno khiyaano, isla markaana—ogolaanshahaaga—u shakhsiyeeyno khibradda.
COOKIES.PREF: Doorbidyadaada waxaad maamuli kartaa mar kasta adigoo adeegsanaya barxadda ogolaanshaha & dejinta browser-ka.

AUTOMATION.TITLE: Go’aanno otomaatig & profayl
AUTOMATION.TEXT: Waxaan adeegsan karnaa calaamado otomaatig ah (khiyaano-khatar, helitaan xirfadle, masaafad) si aan u mudnaanta siino ama u soo jeedino waqtiyo. Go’aan saamayn sharciga leh lama qaato la’aanteed qof bini’aadam ah, ilaa sharci dalbado ama oggolaansho cad jirto.

RIGHTS.TITLE: Xuquuqdaada (GDPR)
RIGHTS.L3: Xuquuq ka hortag marka saldhiggu yahay dano sharci.
RIGHTS.CONTACT: Si aad u adeegsatid xuquuqda, nala soo xiriir:
RIGHTS.VERIFY: Waxaan codsan karnaa xog dheeraad ah si aan u xaqiijino aqoonsigaaga.

SECURITY.TITLE: Amniga
SECURITY.TEXT: Waxaan adeegsanaynaa tallaabooyin farsamo & hab-maamuus: TLS, hash-gareynta erayo sir, log & kormeer, xaddididda helitaanka, kaydin, kormeer code & tijaabooyin amni.

MINORS.TITLE: Xogta carruurta
MINORS.TEXT: Adeeggeennu kuma jihaysna dadka ka yar 15. Haddii aan helno akoon yar, ka dib xaqiijin waan tirtireynaa.

SUBPROCESSORS.TITLE: Hoos-qandaraaslayaal waaweyn
SUBPROCESSORS.TEXT: Waxaan la shaqeynaa martigelin, bixin, e-mailing, analytics, kaydin. Liis la cusboonayn karo waxaa lagu heli karaa codsi u dir

CHANGES.TITLE: Isbeddelka siyaasaddan
CHANGES.TEXT: Waxaan cusboonaysiin karnaa si waafaqsan isbeddel sharci ama hawleed. Haddii isbeddel weyn dhaco, waxaan kuu sheegi doonnaa e-mail ama app. Taariikhda dhaqan galka: 11 Ogoosto 2025.

LOCAL.TITLE: Qodobo maxalli ah
LOCAL.TEXT: Haddii aad ku sugan tahay EU, xogtaada GDPR ayay waafaqsan tahay. Dhammaystiryo gaar ah waddan/degmo ayaa lagu dari karaa.

GLOSSARY.TITLE: Qaamuus (kooban)
GLOSSARY.L1: Mas’uulka xogta: hay’adda go’aamisa ujeeddooyinka & hababka shaqo.
GLOSSARY.L3: Saldhig sharci: sababta sharciga (qandaraas, oggolaansho, waajib sharci, dano sharci).
GLOSSARY.L4: Cookies/SDK: raadraacyo lagu isticmaalo site/app si loo bixiyo, loo qiyaaso, loona shakhsiyeeyo adeegga.

ACCEPT.TITLE: Aqbalidda shuruudaha
ACCEPT.TEXT: Adigoo galaya adeegyada izyGlam (web, app web, app mobile), waxaad si buuxda u aqbalaysaa Shuruudaha Isticmaalka (“CGU”). Haddii aadan aqbalin, ha isticmaalin Madasha.

DEFINITIONS.TITLE: Qeexitaanno
DEFINITIONS.L1: Macmiil: qof kasta oo ballansada/ka bixiya adeeg Madasha.
DEFINITIONS.L2: Xirfadle: qof kasta oo adeeg ku bixiya Madasha.
DEFINITIONS.L3: Adeeg: adeeg uu bixiyo Xirfadle (tusaale qurux guri).
DEFINITIONS.L4: Madal: kaabayaasha software-ka, bogagga & app-yada ay maamusho izyGlam.

SERVICE_ROLE.TITLE: Adeegyada & doorka izyGlam
SERVICE_ROLE.TEXT: izyGlam waa madax-dhaxaad. Xirfadlayaashu waa mas’uul keliya tayada, waafaqidda, caymiska.izyGlam caadiyan ma aha iibiyaha ama fuliyaha, mas’uuliyadda fulintana ma qaado.

ACCOUNT.TITLE: Akoon & u-qalmaansho
ACCOUNT.L1: Diiwaangelin ayaa qasab u ah ballan ama bixinta adeeg. Waxaad ballan qaadayaa xog sax ah oo la cusboonaysiinayo.
ACCOUNT.L2: Waa inaad ka weyn tahay 15 sano si aad u isticmaasho Madasha. Xirfadlayaal waa in sharci ahaan u qalmaan shaqadooda.
ACCOUNT.L3: Adiga ayaa mas’uul ka ah qarsoodiga aqoonsiyadaada iyo wax kasta oo akoonkaaga laga sameeyo.
ACCOUNT.L4: izyGlam waxay xaq u leedahay joojin/ka jaris akoon marka la jabiyo shuruudaha ama khatar khiyaano jirto.

BOOKINGS.TITLE: Ballamo & samaysanka qandaraaska
BOOKINGS.L1: Adeegyada waxaa lagu ballansadaa lana bixiyaa onlayn. Lacag caddaan ah laguma bixiyo goobta.
BOOKINGS.L2: Ballanku wuxuu u baahan yahay xaqiijin Xirfadle kadib bixinta. Haddii la diido, Macmiilku 100% ayuu u helayaa lacag-celin.
BOOKINGS.L3: Qandaraaska adeegga wuxuu si toos ah uga dhexeeyaa Macmiilka & Xirfadlaha marka la aqbalo.
BOOKINGS.L4: Saacadaha, cinwaanada adeegga iyo shuruudaha gaarka ah waa in labada dhinac hubiyaan.

PRICES_PAYMENTS.TITLE: Qiimayaal, isdiiwaangelin & bixin
PRICES_PAYMENTS.L1: Qiimaha adeegyada waxaa dejinaya Xirfadlayaal. izyGlam waxay qaadataa komishan madal.
PRICES_PAYMENTS.L2: Isdiiwaangelin Xirfadlayaal ( tusaale hadda ): 1 saloon bilaash nolosha; Basic: 3 saloon – 99 € / bil; Premium: 10 saloon – 499 € / bil; ka badan: xigasho.
PRICES_PAYMENTS.L3: Bixin kaar bangi kaliya (tusaale Stripe). Lama aqbalo caddaan, koodh dhimis ama daacadnimo weli ma jiro.
PRICES_PAYMENTS.L4: Lacag, canshuur & kharashyo waxaa lagu muujinayaa ka hor xaqiijinta. Shuruudaha isdiiwaangelinta way is beddeli karaan; isbeddellada hore ayaa lagu sii sheegi doonaa.

CANCELLATIONS.TITLE: Kansal, lacag-celin & imaatin la’aan
CANCELLATIONS.L1: Kansal bilaash ah ilaa 24 saac ka hor.
CANCELLATIONS.L2: Ka yar 24 saac, kharashyo ayaa dhaqan geli kara.
CANCELLATIONS.L3: Haddii xirfadlaha diido kadib bixinta, Macmiilku wuxuu helayaa 100% lacag-celin. Otomaatiggu wuu socda; haddii kale support ayaa bilaabaya.
CANCELLATIONS.L4: No-show waxay keeni karaan kharashyo ama in aan lacag-celin la helin.

PAYOUTS.TITLE: Lacag bixinta Xirfadlayaasha
PAYOUTS.L1: Lacag bixintu waxay kicisaa marka adeegga la xaqiijiyo (tusaale koodh xaqiijin).
PAYOUTS.L2: RIB/IBAN uu bixiyay Xirfadlaha ayaa loo adeegsadaa wareejinta. Xirfadluhu wuxuu dammaanad qaadayaa saxnaanta xogta bangiga.
PAYOUTS.L3: Lacagta la bixiyo = qiimaha adeegga ka dib marka laga jaro komishan & kharashyo.

RESPONSIBILITIES.TITLE: Mas’uuliyadaha
RESPONSIBILITIES.L1: Xirfadlayaal: waafaqid sharci, nadaafad, amni & tayo.
RESPONSIBILITIES.L2: Macaamiil: bixinta xog sax ah (cinwaan, helitaan, xaddidaadyo) & ixtiraamid ballan.
RESPONSIBILITIES.L3: izyGlam: waxay bixinaysaa madal & qalab (ballan, bixin, farriin) — natiijo adeeg lama dammaanad qaado.

REVIEWS.TITLE: Faallooyin & qiimeyn
REVIEWS.L1: Faallo waxaa lagu bixiyaa kaliya kadib adeeg dhab ah.
REVIEWS.L2: Faallooyinka waxaa la habeeyaa (tusaale: ka saar wax sharci jabinaya ama ka soo horjeeda CGU).

PROHIBITED.TITLE: Dhaqamo la mamnuucay
PROHIBITED.L1: Khiyaano, magac-bixid been, hareer-marin Madal, ku dhiirrigelin heshiisyo ka baxsan Madal.
PROHIBITED.L2: Nuxur sharci-daro, aflagaado, takoorka, rabshad, anshax xumo.
PROHIBITED.L3: Weerar, DoS, injineernimo rogaal-celis, hareer-marin tallaabooyin amni.
PROHIBITED.L4: Ururin aan la oggolayn oo xog shaqsi ah.

IPR.TITLE: Hantida aqooneed
IPR.TEXT: Nuxurka, calaamadaha & walxaha Madasha (code, naqshad, qoraal, logos, sawirro) waa la ilaaliyo. Iyada oo aan oggolaansho, soo saarid/ qaybin/ habayn waa mamnuuc. Nuxurka ay bixiyaan Xirfadlayaashu waa hantidooda; waxay siisaan izyGlam rukhsad aan gaar ahayn oo lagama maarmaan u ah hawlgalka Madasha.

THIRD_PARTY.TITLE: Adeegyo dhinac saddexaad
THIRD_PARTY.TEXT: Madalka waxa uu ku dhex dari karaa adeegyo (bixin, khariidad, martigelin, analytics). Shuruudahooda ayaa khuseeya. izyGlam mas’uul kama aha hakadkooda ama ciladahooda.

AVAILABILITY.TITLE: Helitaan, dayactir & cusboonaysiin
AVAILABILITY.TEXT: Waxaan beddeli/ joojin/ hakinin karnaa qayb ka mid ah Madasha si dayactir/horumarin. Waxaan ku dadaalaynaa inaan yareyno saameynta.

LIABILITY.TITLE: Xaddidaadda mas’uuliyadda & magdhow
LIABILITY.TEXT: Xadka sharcigu oggol yahay, mas’uuliyadda izyGlam waxay ku egtahay khasaare toos ah; khasaare dadban (fursad lumin, dakhli iwm) lama daboolo. Waxaad ku ballanqaadaysaa inaad magdhowdo izyGlam haddii aad jabiso shuruudaha ama adeegsiga sharci-darro.

TERMINATION.TITLE: Joojin & ka jaris
TERMINATION.TEXT: Waxaad tirtiri kartaa akoonkaaga mar kasta. Waxaan joojin karnaa helitaanka haddii la jabiyo CGU, khiyaano, ama ammar sharci. Qaar ka mid ah qodobbada (tusaale: lacagaha, mas’uuliyad) way sii jiraan kadib joojinta.

PRIVACY.TITLE: Xog shaqsi
PRIVACY.TEXT: Farsamaynta xogtaada waxaa lagu qeexay Siyaasaddeenna Qarsoodiga. Isticmaalka Madalka waxaad aqbalaysaa siyaasaddaas. Ka fiirso xuquuqda GDPR & ballanqaadyadeenna.

CHANGES.TITLE: Isbeddelka CGU
CHANGES.TEXT: Waxaan beddeli karnaa CGU sababo sharci, qorshe ama farsamo. Haddii isbeddel weyn dhaco, waxaan kugu soo wargelin doonnaa e-mail ama app, waxaanan daabici doonnaa nooca cusub.

LAW.TITLE: Sharciga khuseeya & khilaafaadka
LAW.TEXT: CGU waxaa maamula sharciga Faransiiska. Khilaaf kasta waxaa loo gudbinayaa maxkamadaha fadhigooda ay ku taallo izyGlam, haddii aanay jirin qodobo macmiil u roon oo khasab ah.

EFFECTIVE.TITLE: Taariikhda dhaqan-galka
EFFECTIVE.TEXT: CGU waxay dhaqan gashay 25 December 2025 waxayna beddeshay noocyadii hore.
